01服务实例、探针与控制链

从一条正常请求认识四个对象

先部署一个运行两个副本的服务。客户端请求固定入口，转发组件在就绪副本中选择后端，应用返回它真正运行的版本。先把这条正常请求走通，再分别改变健康信号和版本，继续用同一入口核对用户实际收到什么。

Deployment 声明“运行两个副本”，控制器据此创建 Pod；Pod 是容器运行的单位，每个对象都有独立 UID。Service 用标签选择这一组 Pod，提供稳定的集群内 IP（ClusterIP）。EndpointSlice 保存后端地址和就绪条件，转发组件观察这些对象、更新转发规则。节点代理 kubelet 按探针检查应用，再更新就绪或推进容器重启。Service 不是额外业务进程，EndpointSlice 也不承载 HTTP 请求。

正常路径中，两个业务 Pod 都是 Ready，端点 ready=true；持续客户端确实从同一个 ClusterIP 收到两个 UID 的 v1 响应。接下来分别观察“是否接新流量”“是否重启”和“运行哪个版本”，三个问题使用不同证据。

历史来源：原有本地机制实验（保留原文）

以下是本次原生实验之前的材料，其中“本轮未执行 / 待验证”描述旧手册当时的状态。旧本地结果仍属于 infra_lab.py；本次记录属于独立的 service_lab.py 双副本与持续客户端夹具，两者分别验收。

本地脚本仅使用Python标准库：真实loopback HTTP请求、文件版本提交与摘要校验，以及SLO、推理时序和任务契约的固定样例。运行失败会以非零状态退出，报告保留环境与每项断言结果。

Kubernetes手册使用独立教学服务，不申请云资源。它要求已有测试集群，本轮没有执行，因此集群预期不是实测结论。Python的http.server适合这个教学实验，不作为生产服务实现。

02探针条件与容器重启

先给健康信号各自的职责

应用提供 /ready、/live 和 /work；节点上的 kubelet 按配置周期请求前两个接口。readiness 回答“现在是否适合接新工作”：失败会影响 Pod Ready 和端点就绪。liveness 回答“是否需要靠重启恢复”：连续失败达到阈值后，kubelet 重启相应容器。Running 只说明生命周期阶段，不能替代这两种判断。

下面的字段属于同一份双副本夹具。Service 的 80 端口转到应用 8080；selector 与 Pod 标签 app=guide-service 对应。探针直接检查 Pod 应用；客户端仍请求 Service，不把探针请求当作业务流量。

对象核心字段 · 完整可运行对象见本节源码
# 同一个 guide-service 的核心字段；完整对象由实验程序创建
# Deployment.spec.template.spec.containers[0]
env: [{name: APP_VERSION, value: v1}]
readinessProbe:
  httpGet: {path: /ready, port: 8080}
  periodSeconds: 1
  failureThreshold: 1
livenessProbe:
  httpGet: {path: /live, port: 8080}
  periodSeconds: 2
  failureThreshold: 3
# Service.spec：selector 匹配 Pod 标签
selector: {app: guide-service}
ports: [{port: 80, targetPort: 8080}]

当 /ready 失败而 /live、/work 仍成功时，应用进程仍有处理能力，但不再适合接新工作。探针只提供信号；是否减少新流量，要继续看平台如何更新端点和转发规则。下面以同一个 /work 请求验证这条因果链。

03Service 请求与后端条件

应用能响应，不等于 Service 仍会选择它

独立客户端 Pod 持续向 http://10.96.63.29/work 发请求。每次使用新连接和唯一请求 ID，响应回显这个 ID、实际 APP_VERSION 与 Pod UID。管理端另读 API；因此“应用返回了什么”和“平台把谁标为就绪”可以相互核对。

同一正常请求的核心 API · 在客户端 Pod 内执行
# 客户端 Pod 内；service_url 固定为本次 ClusterIP 的 /work
request_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
request = urllib.request.Request(service_url,
    headers={'X-Request-ID': request_id, 'Connection': 'close'})
opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
with opener.open(request, timeout=2) as response:
    body = json.load(response)
    assert response.status == 200
    assert body['request_id'] == request_id
    # 再核对 body['version'] 与 body['pod_uid']

只在一个业务容器创建 /tmp/not-ready 后，该 Pod 的 /ready=503，/live=200、/work=200。API 观察到 Pod Ready=false、对应 EndpointSlice ready=false；其地址仍可留在对象中。对象收敛后，连续 20 条 Service 响应只来自另一 Pod，两个 Pod 的重启次数均未增加。删除标记后，同一 UID 恢复就绪，响应再次覆盖两个后端。

再单独让 /live 失败，/ready 此时仍为 200。达到本例阈值后，同一 Pod UID 的容器重启一次，restartCount 从 0 变为 1，响应中的进程实例 ID 也改变。readiness 失败期间没有重启，liveness 失败后发生重启，两条因果路径由不同注入与实测区分。

客户端阶段标签完整序列请求数非 200 / 传输失败选取的稳定窗口
正常 v127020 条均 200
readiness 失败31020 条均 200
readiness 恢复84120 条均 200
liveness 重启后67020 条均 200
发布 v265020 条均 200
undo 回 v122020 条均 200

阶段标签在 API 收敛后切换，因此完整阶段也会包含随后故障注入与传播中的请求；右列是其中满足条件的一段，不能代表全程零错误、负载均衡公平或服务 SLO。

按需：采样窗口、传播与终止边界

程序等待对象状态，再切换客户端阶段标记，直到最后连续 20 条成功、实际 UID 集合与 ready 后端集合一致；采样前后各读一次 API。达到条件前的请求仍在原始记录中。稳定窗口不能证明传播期间零失败，也不能保证未来所有请求；端点状态与数据平面之间仍有异步传播。

本例关闭连接复用，只检查受控新请求。长连接、在途请求、preStop 排空和云负载均衡的健康检查需要独立实验；不从几秒固定等待推断它们已完成。Pod 内 loopback 诊断只用来核对三个应用接口，不计入 Service 业务样本。

历史来源：原有目标集群手册与源码（保留原文）

以下是本次原生实验之前的材料，其中“本轮未执行 / 待验证”描述旧手册当时的状态。旧本地结果仍属于 infra_lab.py；本次记录属于独立的 service_lab.py 双副本与持续客户端夹具，两者分别验收。

手册先创建专用namespace，将probe_server.py作为ConfigMap挂载，部署一个副本并暴露Service。通过创建/tmp/not-ready使/ready返回503，再观察Pod Ready、EndpointSlice ready条件与restartCount。

预期readiness失败影响端点就绪状态，而不因它本身触发重启。直接port-forward到Pod会绕过Service后端选择，不能拿它仍能访问来证明readiness无效。

展开deployment.yaml
deployment.yaml · 目标集群待验证 YAML
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: infra-demo
  namespace: infra-guide-lab
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: infra-demo
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: infra-demo
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: python:3.12-slim
          command: ["python", "/app/probe_server.py"]
          env:
            - name: APP_VERSION
              value: v1
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 128Mi
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /live
              port: 8080
            periodSeconds: 2
            failureThreshold: 30
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /ready
              port: 8080
            periodSeconds: 2
            failureThreshold: 1
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /live
              port: 8080
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 3
          volumeMounts:
            - name: code
              mountPath: /app
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: code
          configMap:
            name: infra-lab-code
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: infra-demo
  namespace: infra-guide-lab
spec:
  selector:
    app: infra-demo
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080

04模板修订、发布与回退

模板变化、Pod 变化与用户版本是三个时刻

APP_VERSION 位于 Deployment 的 Pod 模板中。将它从 v1 改为 v2，会触发控制器创建新版本副本；本例 maxUnavailable=0、maxSurge=1，允许先增加一份，再逐步替换。等待 rollout 完成后，还要检查新 Pod 的 Ready、端点 UID 和实际 HTTP 版本。Service 的 UID 与 ClusterIP 在整个发布中保持相同。

发布与回退核心 API · 使用本次私有管理上下文
# 程序的 self.k 始终带本次私有 kubeconfig/context/namespace
self.k('set', 'env', 'deployment/guide-service', 'APP_VERSION=v2')
self.k('rollout', 'status', 'deployment/guide-service', '--timeout=180s')
# 等待 Pod/EndpointSlice 后，再经同一 ClusterIP 读取实际 v2
self.k('rollout', 'undo', 'deployment/guide-service', '--to-revision=1')
self.k('rollout', 'status', 'deployment/guide-service', '--timeout=180s')
# 再等对象并实际读取 v1；不把命令成功当作请求结果
阶段同一 Service 的实际响应继续核对
初始版本20 / 20 返回 v1响应覆盖两个初始 Pod UID
发布新模板20 / 20 返回 v2响应 UID 属于新模板 Pod
undo 初始模板20 / 20 再次返回 v1Ready、端点与回退后 Pod UID 一致

rollout undo 回退的是历史 Pod 模板。这里版本来自模板环境变量，因此回退后真实读到 v1；如果模板引用的同名 ConfigMap 内容或数据库结构另有变化，它们不会随这条命令自动恢复。先识别版本来自哪里，再决定需要恢复哪些外部状态。

历史来源：原有目标集群手册与源码（保留原文）

以下是本次原生实验之前的材料，其中“本轮未执行 / 待验证”描述旧手册当时的状态。旧本地结果仍属于 infra_lab.py；本次记录属于独立的 service_lab.py 双副本与持续客户端夹具，两者分别验收。

使用APP_VERSION把v1改成v2，这会修改Pod模板。等待rollout后，在测试环境访问应用响应，检查实际版本字段；rollout undo后重新检查v1。仅命令成功不足以说明读者看到的服务版本已恢复。

只清理本实验新建的namespace。若同名namespace已存在，先确认归属并调整实验名称，不能把其他人的资源混入或删掉。完整命令与边界见下方手册。

README.md MARKDOWN
# InfraGuide · Cloud / AI / Agent 系统实验包

Python 3.9+，仅使用标准库。本地实验不申请云资源、不访问外部业务、不调用真实模型或 Kairo。
本包用小系统验证语义，不是生产实现或性能基准。

## 1. 一次执行 Cloud 与 AI 机制实验

```bash
python3 infra_lab.py --output runs/core-report.json
```

包含五项：
- HTTP：真实 loopback 请求，区分 200、503、404；readiness 变为 503 时 liveness 仍为 200，业务路径仍能执行。没有编排器，所以不会自动摘除流量。
- 存储：完整版本校验后发布 CURRENT；半成品不发布；摘要不匹配被拒绝；最后完整版本可恢复。
- SLO：人工事件计数 fixture，989/1000 成功；99%目标下允许10个坏事件，实际11个，burn rate约1.1。空窗口返回无数据。
- 推理指标：人工时间线fixture；A的客户端TTFT为400ms，调度至首token为200ms，TPOT为20ms；单token请求TPOT为空；没有执行模型。
- 任务契约：必要字段和形状校验；缺数据版本被拒绝。示例摘要、代码版本、URI为虚构占位，校验不证明工件存在或有权访问。

断言失败时进程非零退出；正常时所有 results.*.status 为 passed。
HTTP时间是本机单次观察，不可作为服务SLA、云延迟或容量基准。

## 2. Agent崩溃恢复与幂等实验

```bash
python3 agent_lab.py --output runs/agent-report.json
```

runner.sqlite 和 tool.sqlite 是独立数据库。子进程在工具效果已提交后，以23退出，模拟完成记录尚未写入的窗口。
重启用同一 operation ID 再调用工具；工具端原子去重，最终 runner=SUCCEEDED、attempts=2、tool_effects=1。
还验证重复读取已完成结果、同ID不同payload拒绝、未授权工具拒绝。

关键限制：效果只有一次依赖接收工具支持稳定幂等键与原子去重；只在runner记账不足以保证外部效果只有一次。
本实验只有一个worker，不覆盖多worker租约、fencing、远程服务网络分区、断电耐久性、LLM质量或Kairo实现。
脚本用临时目录创建数据库，退出后自动清理；报告保留在指定路径。

## 3. Kubernetes探针与发布手册（目标集群待验证）

需要已有独立测试集群与kubectl权限。确认当前context指向测试环境。
python:3.12-slim 是便于实验的可变标签；可重复的正式环境应记录实际镜像digest。

```bash
kubectl config current-context
kubectl create namespace infra-guide-lab
kubectl -n infra-guide-lab create configmap infra-lab-code --from-file=probe_server.py
kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml
kubectl -n infra-guide-lab rollout status deployment/infra-demo --timeout=120s
kubectl -n infra-guide-lab get pods
kubectl -n infra-guide-lab get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=infra-demo -o yaml
```

使readiness失败（仅此专用实验部署）：

```bash
kubectl -n infra-guide-lab exec deploy/infra-demo -- python -c "from pathlib import Path; Path('/tmp/not-ready').touch()"
kubectl -n infra-guide-lab get pods
kubectl -n infra-guide-lab get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=infra-demo -o yaml
kubectl -n infra-guide-lab get pods -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{" "}{.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount}{"\n"}{end}'
```

预期：Pod Ready=False，EndpointSlice对应endpoint的ready条件为false；容器不因readiness本身重启。
不要求EndpointSlice中的IP条目一定消失。直接port-forward到Pod可能绕过Service后端选择，不能据此证明readiness失效。

恢复并演练模板发布/回滚：

```bash
kubectl -n infra-guide-lab exec deploy/infra-demo -- python -c "from pathlib import Path; Path('/tmp/not-ready').unlink(missing_ok=True)"
kubectl -n infra-guide-lab set env deployment/infra-demo APP_VERSION=v2
kubectl -n infra-guide-lab rollout status deployment/infra-demo --timeout=120s
kubectl -n infra-guide-lab rollout undo deployment/infra-demo
kubectl -n infra-guide-lab rollout status deployment/infra-demo --timeout=120s
```

可在另一个终端运行 `kubectl -n infra-guide-lab port-forward deployment/infra-demo 18080:8080`，再用 `curl http://127.0.0.1:18080/` 核对响应版本。Pod替换后可能需要重新运行port-forward；这一步只验证应用版本，不验证Service摘流。

核对Pod模板中的APP_VERSION和实际响应都回到v1。这里回滚的是Pod模板，不是外部数据库或模型仓库。
清理只针对本实验创建的专用命名空间：kubectl delete namespace infra-guide-lab。
若命名空间已存在，应先检查归属，不要将别人的资源混入实验或删除。

## 4. 验证记录与复现

validation.json记录本次实际执行环境、结果、脚本摘要和未验证项。
改变Python脚本后需重跑相应验证再生成发布包。
不用把临时目录内容、真实token或私有项目数据写入报告。

05原生实验、源码与验收

自己运行，并用业务结果验收

先预测：只让 /ready 失败，Pod UID、restartCount、端点条件与客户端 UID 分别会怎样变化？再预测只让 /live 失败和回退模板的结果。下载完整程序，在 Linux、本机 Docker、kind v0.33.0、kubectl v1.35.8 与 Python 3.9+ 环境运行：

运行独立原生实验；第二条仅离线复核记录
python3 -B service_lab.py --output service-record.json
python3 -B service_lab.py --check-record service-record.json

验收依次核对请求 ID、版本、Pod UID，以及独立读取的 Ready、EndpointSlice 和重启次数；任意一项失配都不能用命令成功替代。实验创建随机命名的专有 kind 集群，显式使用自己的 kubeconfig/context，退出时只删除该集群。

本次记录来自单 Linux 宿主的 kind，验证原生探针、真实 ClusterIP 数据路径与模板恢复。它不代表生产云网络、多故障域可用性、容量或长连接排空。原有本地实验继续解释应用、文件与指标机制，不替代本次 Kubernetes 对象与业务结果。

"""Observe probes, real ClusterIP requests, a template rollout and rollback in an owned kind cluster."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import ipaddress
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import uuid

NODE_IMAGE = 'kindest/node:v1.35.8@sha256:07b2536e30b803ed61d1677a79df6115f798ce64c80f9e22f6ed45afd09323c0'
PYTHON_IMAGE = 'python:3.13.7-alpine3.22@sha256:9ba6d8cbebf0fb6546ae71f2a1c14f6ffd2fdab83af7fa5669734ef30ad48844'
NAMESPACE = 'service-lab'
SAMPLE_SIZE = 20
APP_CODE = r'''
import json,os,uuid
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
INSTANCE = uuid.uuid4().hex
class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def do_GET(self):
  path=urlsplit(self.path).path
  status=200
  if path=='/ready' and Path('/tmp/not-ready').exists():status=503
  elif path=='/live' and Path('/tmp/not-live').exists():status=503
  elif path not in ('/ready','/live','/work'):status=404
  body=json.dumps({'version':os.environ['APP_VERSION'],'pod_uid':os.environ['POD_UID'],
   'pod_name':os.environ['POD_NAME'],'instance_id':INSTANCE,'path':path,
   'request_id':self.headers.get('X-Request-ID',''),'status':status}).encode()
  self.send_response(status);self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json')
  self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)));self.send_header('Connection','close')
  self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(body);self.close_connection=True
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0',8080),Handler).serve_forever()
'''
CLIENT_CODE = r'''
import json,os,time,uuid,urllib.request,urllib.error
from pathlib import Path
url=os.environ['SERVICE_URL']
seq=0
opener=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
while True:
 seq+=1
 phase=Path('/tmp/phase').read_text().strip() if Path('/tmp/phase').exists() else 'startup'
 request_id=uuid.uuid4().hex
 row={'seq':seq,'phase':phase,'request_id':request_id,'url':url,
      'started_at':time.time(),'new_connection':True}
 request=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'X-Request-ID':request_id,'Connection':'close'})
 try:
  with opener.open(request,timeout=2) as response:
   row.update(status=response.status,body=json.load(response))
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
  row.update(status=error.code,body=json.load(error));error.close()
 except Exception as error:
  row.update(status=None,error_type=type(error).__name__)
 row['completed_at']=time.time()
 print(json.dumps(row,separators=(',',':')),flush=True)
 time.sleep(.2)
'''


def source_sha():
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def ready_uids(snapshot):
    return {row['pod_uid'] for row in snapshot['endpoints'] if row['conditions'].get('ready') is True}


def verify(o):
    """Use actual response identities and independent API observations, not command exit codes."""
    assert o['client']['path'] == 'in-cluster client Pod -> Service ClusterIP:80 -> Pod:8080'
    cluster_ip = o['client']['cluster_ip']
    assert ipaddress.ip_address(cluster_ip).is_private
    assert o['client']['service_url'] == 'http://' + cluster_ip + '/work'
    assert o['client']['environment_proxy_used'] is False
    assert o['client']['port_forward_used'] is False
    requests = o['requests']
    by_seq = {r['seq']: r for r in requests}
    assert len(by_seq) == len(requests) and len(requests) >= SAMPLE_SIZE * 6
    assert len({r['request_id'] for r in requests}) == len(requests)
    for row in requests:
        assert row['url'] == o['client']['service_url'] and row['new_connection'] is True
        assert row['completed_at'] >= row['started_at']
        if row.get('status') == 200:
            assert row['body']['request_id'] == row['request_id']
            assert row['body']['path'] == '/work' and row['body']['status'] == 200
    cases = o['cases']
    names = ('normal_v1', 'readiness_failed', 'readiness_recovered', 'liveness_restarted', 'rolled_v2', 'undo_v1')
    assert set(cases) == set(names)
    all_sample_ids = set()
    for name in names:
        case = cases[name]
        before, after = case['api_before'], case['api_after']
        assert before['service'] == after['service'] == o['service']
        assert before['service']['cluster_ip'] == cluster_ip
        assert len(before['pods']) == len(after['pods']) == 2
        assert {r['uid'] for r in before['pods']} == {r['uid'] for r in after['pods']}
        assert ready_uids(before) == ready_uids(after)
        samples = [by_seq[i] for i in case['sample_sequences']]
        assert len(samples) == SAMPLE_SIZE
        assert len(set(case['sample_sequences'])) == SAMPLE_SIZE
        assert not (all_sample_ids & set(case['sample_sequences']))
        all_sample_ids.update(case['sample_sequences'])
        assert case['sample_sequences'] == list(range(samples[0]['seq'], samples[0]['seq'] + SAMPLE_SIZE))
        assert all(r['phase'] == name and r['status'] == 200 for r in samples)
        expected = ready_uids(after)
        assert {r['body']['pod_uid'] for r in samples} == expected
        version = 'v2' if name == 'rolled_v2' else 'v1'
        assert all(r['body']['version'] == version for r in samples)
        for snapshot in (before, after):
            assert snapshot['deployment']['template_version'] == version
            assert snapshot['deployment']['observed_generation'] >= snapshot['deployment']['generation']
            for pod in snapshot['pods']:
                assert pod['version'] == version and pod['deleting'] is False
                endpoint = [e for e in snapshot['endpoints'] if e['pod_uid'] == pod['uid']]
                assert len(endpoint) == 1 and endpoint[0]['addresses'] == [pod['ip']]
                assert endpoint[0]['conditions'].get('ready') == pod['ready']
                assert endpoint[0]['conditions'].get('terminating', False) is False
        assert all(p['ready'] for p in after['pods']) if name != 'readiness_failed' else True
    normal = {p['uid']: p for p in cases['normal_v1']['api_after']['pods']}
    victim = o['readiness']['pod_uid']
    assert victim in normal and len(ready_uids(cases['normal_v1']['api_after'])) == 2
    for name in ('readiness_failed', 'readiness_recovered'):
        for snapshot in (cases[name]['api_before'], cases[name]['api_after']):
            assert {p['uid'] for p in snapshot['pods']} == set(normal)
            assert all(p['restart_count'] == normal[p['uid']]['restart_count'] for p in snapshot['pods'])
    failed = cases['readiness_failed']['api_after']
    assert ready_uids(failed) == set(normal) - {victim}
    assert next(p for p in failed['pods'] if p['uid'] == victim)['ready'] is False
    assert o['readiness']['direct_probe']['ready']['status'] == 503
    assert o['readiness']['direct_probe']['live']['status'] == 200
    assert o['readiness']['direct_probe']['work']['status'] == 200
    assert all(r['body']['pod_uid'] == victim for r in o['readiness']['direct_probe'].values())
    assert ready_uids(cases['readiness_recovered']['api_after']) == set(normal)
    restarted = {p['uid']: p for p in cases['liveness_restarted']['api_after']['pods']}
    assert set(restarted) == set(normal)
    assert restarted[victim]['restart_count'] == normal[victim]['restart_count'] + 1
    assert all(p['restart_count'] == normal[uid]['restart_count'] for uid,p in restarted.items() if uid != victim)
    assert o['liveness']['direct_probe']['live']['status'] == 503
    assert o['liveness']['direct_probe']['ready']['status'] == 200
    old_instance = o['readiness']['direct_probe']['work']['body']['instance_id']
    after_instances = {by_seq[i]['body']['instance_id'] for i in cases['liveness_restarted']['sample_sequences']
                       if by_seq[i]['body']['pod_uid'] == victim}
    assert len(after_instances) == 1 and old_instance not in after_instances
    v2 = cases['rolled_v2']['api_after']
    undo = cases['undo_v1']['api_after']
    assert ready_uids(v2).isdisjoint(set(normal)) and ready_uids(undo).isdisjoint(ready_uids(v2))
    assert o['rollout']['undo_to_revision'] == 1
    assert cases['normal_v1']['api_after']['deployment']['revision'] == '1'
    assert int(v2['deployment']['revision']) >= 2
    assert int(undo['deployment']['revision']) > int(v2['deployment']['revision'])


class Lab:
    def __init__(self):
        self.name = 'infra-service-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
        self.kubeconfig = None
        self.created = False
        self.stage = 'preflight'
        self.observation = {'cases': {}, 'requests': []}

    def command(self, *argv, data=None, check=True, timeout=180):
        result = subprocess.run(argv, input=data, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
        if check and result.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError('Command failed at ' + self.stage + ' (exit ' + str(result.returncode) + ')')
        return result

    def k(self, *args, data=None):
        return self.command('kubectl', '--kubeconfig', str(self.kubeconfig), '--context', 'kind-' + self.name,
                            '--request-timeout=15s', '-n', NAMESPACE, *args, data=data)

    def apply(self, obj):
        self.k('apply', '-f', '-', data=json.dumps(obj))

    def get(self, resource, *args):
        return json.loads(self.k('get', resource, *args, '-o', 'json').stdout)

    def wait(self, predicate, description, seconds=150):
        self.stage = description
        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            value = predicate()
            if value:
                return value
            time.sleep(.4)
        raise AssertionError('Deadline exceeded: ' + description)

    def snapshot(self):
        service = self.get('service', 'guide-service')
        deployment = self.get('deployment', 'guide-service')
        pods = self.get('pods', '-l', 'app=guide-service').get('items') or []
        slices = self.get('endpointslices.discovery.k8s.io', '-l', 'kubernetes.io/service-name=guide-service').get('items') or []
        result = {'service': {'uid': service['metadata']['uid'], 'cluster_ip': service['spec']['clusterIP'],
                             'port': service['spec']['ports'][0]['port'], 'target_port': service['spec']['ports'][0]['targetPort'],
                             'selector': service['spec']['selector'],
                             'publish_not_ready_addresses': service['spec'].get('publishNotReadyAddresses', False)},
            'deployment': {'uid': deployment['metadata']['uid'], 'generation': deployment['metadata']['generation'],
                'observed_generation': (deployment.get('status') or {}).get('observedGeneration', 0),
                'revision': (deployment['metadata'].get('annotations') or {}).get('deployment.kubernetes.io/revision', ''),
                'template_version': next(e['value'] for e in deployment['spec']['template']['spec']['containers'][0]['env'] if e['name'] == 'APP_VERSION')},
            'pods': [], 'endpoints': []}
        for pod in pods:
            status = pod.get('status') or {}
            statuses = status.get('containerStatuses') or []
            result['pods'].append({'name': pod['metadata']['name'], 'uid': pod['metadata']['uid'],
                'ip': status.get('podIP'), 'deleting': bool(pod['metadata'].get('deletionTimestamp')),
                'ready': any(c['type'] == 'Ready' and c['status'] == 'True' for c in (status.get('conditions') or [])),
                'restart_count': sum(c['restartCount'] for c in statuses),
                'version': next(e['value'] for e in pod['spec']['containers'][0]['env'] if e['name'] == 'APP_VERSION')})
        for slice_ in slices:
            for endpoint in (slice_.get('endpoints') or []):
                result['endpoints'].append({'slice_uid': slice_['metadata']['uid'], 'addresses': endpoint['addresses'],
                    'pod_uid': (endpoint.get('targetRef') or {}).get('uid'), 'conditions': endpoint.get('conditions') or {}})
        result['pods'].sort(key=lambda p: p['uid'])
        result['endpoints'].sort(key=lambda e: e['pod_uid'] or '')
        return result

    def converged(self, version, unavailable=None, restarts=None):
        s = self.snapshot()
        if len(s['pods']) != 2 or any(p['deleting'] or p['version'] != version or not p['ip'] for p in s['pods']):
            return False
        expected = {p['uid'] for p in s['pods'] if p['uid'] != unavailable}
        if ready_uids(s) != expected or len(s['endpoints']) != 2:
            return False
        if any(p['ready'] != (p['uid'] != unavailable) for p in s['pods']):
            return False
        if restarts and any(p['restart_count'] != restarts[p['uid']] for p in s['pods']):
            return False
        if s['deployment']['observed_generation'] < s['deployment']['generation']:
            return False
        return s

    def read_requests(self):
        lines = self.k('logs', 'service-client').stdout.splitlines()
        return [json.loads(line) for line in lines if line.strip()]

    def sample(self, case, snapshot, version):
        self.stage = 'sample real Service requests: ' + case
        self.k('exec', 'service-client', '--', 'python', '-c',
               "from pathlib import Path;Path('/tmp/phase.next').write_text(" + repr(case) + ");Path('/tmp/phase.next').replace('/tmp/phase')")
        expected = ready_uids(snapshot)
        def success():
            rows = [r for r in self.read_requests() if r['phase'] == case]
            tail = rows[-SAMPLE_SIZE:]
            if len(tail) != SAMPLE_SIZE:
                return False
            if not all(r.get('status') == 200 and r['body']['version'] == version and
                       r['body']['request_id'] == r['request_id'] and r['body']['pod_uid'] in expected for r in tail):
                return False
            if {r['body']['pod_uid'] for r in tail} != expected:
                return False
            return tail
        rows = self.wait(success, self.stage, 90)
        after = self.snapshot()
        self.observation['cases'][case] = {'api_before': snapshot, 'api_after': after,
            'sample_sequences': [r['seq'] for r in rows],
            'phase_requests_observed': len([r for r in self.read_requests() if r['phase'] == case])}

    def direct_probe(self, pod):
        # This is a named diagnostic from inside one Pod. It is never counted as Service traffic.
        script = """import json,urllib.request,urllib.error
result={}
for path in ('ready','live','work'):
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8080/'+path,timeout=3) as response:
   result[path]={'status':response.status,'body':json.load(response)}
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
  result[path]={'status':error.code,'body':json.load(error)};error.close()
print(json.dumps(result))"""
        return json.loads(self.k('exec', pod, '--', 'python', '-c', script).stdout)

    def marker(self, pod, name, exists):
        self.k('exec', pod, '--', 'python', '-c',
               "from pathlib import Path;p=Path('/tmp/" + name + "');" + ("p.touch()" if exists else "p.unlink()"))

    def run(self, folder):
        assert platform.system() == 'Linux', 'Native lab requires Linux'
        for executable in ('docker', 'kind', 'kubectl'):
            assert shutil.which(executable), 'Missing ' + executable
        assert not os.environ.get('DOCKER_HOST'), 'DOCKER_HOST overrides are not accepted'
        assert not os.environ.get('KIND_EXPERIMENTAL_PROVIDER'), 'Use the Docker kind provider'
        endpoint = json.loads(self.command('docker', 'context', 'inspect').stdout)[0]['Endpoints']['docker']['Host']
        assert endpoint.startswith('unix://'), 'Only local Docker Unix sockets are accepted'
        assert self.name not in self.command('kind', 'get', 'clusters').stdout.splitlines()
        kind_version = self.command('kind', 'version').stdout.strip()
        assert kind_version.split()[1] == 'v0.33.0', 'Use pinned kind v0.33.0'
        client_version = json.loads(self.command('kubectl', 'version', '--client', '-o', 'json').stdout)['clientVersion']['gitVersion']
        assert client_version == 'v1.35.8', 'Use pinned kubectl v1.35.8'
        self.kubeconfig = folder / 'kubeconfig'
        self.stage = 'create owned cluster'
        self.created = True
        self.command('kind', 'create', 'cluster', '--name', self.name, '--kubeconfig', str(self.kubeconfig),
                     '--image', NODE_IMAGE, '--wait', '150s', timeout=400)
        self.kubeconfig.chmod(0o600)
        self.stage = 'prepare isolated objects'
        self.apply({'apiVersion': 'v1', 'kind': 'Namespace', 'metadata': {'name': NAMESPACE}})
        self.apply({'apiVersion': 'v1', 'kind': 'ConfigMap', 'metadata': {'name': 'service-code', 'namespace': NAMESPACE},
                    'data': {'app.py': APP_CODE, 'client.py': CLIENT_CODE}})
        pod_spec = {'automountServiceAccountToken': False, 'terminationGracePeriodSeconds': 5,
            'containers': [{'name': 'app', 'image': PYTHON_IMAGE, 'command': ['python', '-u', '/code/app.py'],
                'ports': [{'name': 'http', 'containerPort': 8080}],
                'env': [{'name': 'APP_VERSION', 'value': 'v1'},
                    {'name': 'POD_UID', 'valueFrom': {'fieldRef': {'fieldPath': 'metadata.uid'}}},
                    {'name': 'POD_NAME', 'valueFrom': {'fieldRef': {'fieldPath': 'metadata.name'}}}],
                'readinessProbe': {'httpGet': {'path': '/ready', 'port': 'http'}, 'periodSeconds': 1, 'failureThreshold': 1},
                'livenessProbe': {'httpGet': {'path': '/live', 'port': 'http'}, 'periodSeconds': 2, 'failureThreshold': 3},
                'resources': {'requests': {'cpu': '25m', 'memory': '24Mi'}, 'limits': {'memory': '96Mi'}},
                'volumeMounts': [{'name': 'code', 'mountPath': '/code', 'readOnly': True}]}],
            'volumes': [{'name': 'code', 'configMap': {'name': 'service-code'}}]}
        self.apply({'apiVersion': 'apps/v1', 'kind': 'Deployment', 'metadata': {'name': 'guide-service', 'namespace': NAMESPACE},
            'spec': {'replicas': 2, 'revisionHistoryLimit': 3, 'selector': {'matchLabels': {'app': 'guide-service'}},
                'strategy': {'type': 'RollingUpdate', 'rollingUpdate': {'maxUnavailable': 0, 'maxSurge': 1}},
                'template': {'metadata': {'labels': {'app': 'guide-service'}}, 'spec': pod_spec}}})
        self.apply({'apiVersion': 'v1', 'kind': 'Service', 'metadata': {'name': 'guide-service', 'namespace': NAMESPACE},
            'spec': {'selector': {'app': 'guide-service'}, 'ports': [{'port': 80, 'targetPort': 8080}]}})
        initial = self.wait(lambda: self.converged('v1'), 'initial ready Pods and EndpointSlices', 240)
        self.observation['service'] = initial['service']
        cluster_ip = initial['service']['cluster_ip']
        self.observation['client'] = {'path': 'in-cluster client Pod -> Service ClusterIP:80 -> Pod:8080',
            'cluster_ip': cluster_ip, 'service_url': 'http://' + cluster_ip + '/work',
            'environment_proxy_used': False, 'port_forward_used': False}
        self.apply({'apiVersion': 'v1', 'kind': 'Pod', 'metadata': {'name': 'service-client', 'namespace': NAMESPACE},
            'spec': {'automountServiceAccountToken': False, 'restartPolicy': 'Never',
                'containers': [{'name': 'client', 'image': PYTHON_IMAGE, 'command': ['python', '-u', '/code/client.py'],
                    'env': [{'name': 'SERVICE_URL', 'value': self.observation['client']['service_url']}],
                    'resources': {'requests': {'cpu': '10m', 'memory': '24Mi'}, 'limits': {'memory': '96Mi'}},
                    'volumeMounts': [{'name': 'code', 'mountPath': '/code', 'readOnly': True}]}],
                'volumes': [{'name': 'code', 'configMap': {'name': 'service-code'}}]}})
        self.k('wait', 'pod/service-client', '--for=condition=Ready', '--timeout=180s')
        self.sample('normal_v1', initial, 'v1')
        victim = initial['pods'][0]
        counts = {p['uid']: p['restart_count'] for p in initial['pods']}
        self.stage = 'inject readiness failure in one Pod'
        self.marker(victim['name'], 'not-ready', True)
        self.observation['readiness'] = {'pod_uid': victim['uid'], 'direct_probe': self.direct_probe(victim['name'])}
        failed = self.wait(lambda: self.converged('v1', victim['uid'], counts), 'wait Ready false and endpoint ready false')
        self.sample('readiness_failed', failed, 'v1')
        self.stage = 'recover same Pod readiness'
        self.marker(victim['name'], 'not-ready', False)
        recovered = self.wait(lambda: self.converged('v1', restarts=counts), 'wait same Pods recover readiness')
        self.sample('readiness_recovered', recovered, 'v1')
        self.stage = 'inject liveness failure separately'
        self.marker(victim['name'], 'not-live', True)
        self.observation['liveness'] = {'pod_uid': victim['uid'], 'direct_probe': self.direct_probe(victim['name'])}
        restarted_counts = dict(counts)
        restarted_counts[victim['uid']] += 1
        restarted = self.wait(lambda: self.converged('v1', restarts=restarted_counts), 'wait liveness restart and readiness recovery')
        self.sample('liveness_restarted', restarted, 'v1')
        self.stage = 'change Deployment template to v2'
        self.k('set', 'env', 'deployment/guide-service', 'APP_VERSION=v2')
        self.k('rollout', 'status', 'deployment/guide-service', '--timeout=180s')
        v2 = self.wait(lambda: self.converged('v2'), 'wait v2 Pods and endpoints')
        self.sample('rolled_v2', v2, 'v2')
        self.stage = 'undo Deployment template to revision 1'
        self.k('rollout', 'undo', 'deployment/guide-service', '--to-revision=1')
        self.k('rollout', 'status', 'deployment/guide-service', '--timeout=180s')
        undone = self.wait(lambda: self.converged('v1'), 'wait rollback v1 Pods and endpoints')
        self.sample('undo_v1', undone, 'v1')
        self.observation['rollout'] = {'undo_to_revision': 1, 'changed_field': 'spec.template.spec.containers[name=app].env[APP_VERSION]'}
        self.observation['requests'] = self.read_requests()
        self.stage = 'verify independent API and business response oracle'
        verify(self.observation)
        return {'kind': kind_version, 'kubectl': client_version,
                'kubernetes': json.loads(self.k('version', '-o', 'json').stdout)['serverVersion']['gitVersion']}

    def cleanup(self):
        if not self.created:
            return {'complete': True, 'owned_cluster_absent': True, 'delete_attempted': False}
        self.stage = 'delete owned cluster'
        deleted = self.command('kind', 'delete', 'cluster', '--name', self.name, check=False)
        remaining = self.command('kind', 'get', 'clusters', check=False)
        absent = remaining.returncode == 0 and self.name not in remaining.stdout.splitlines()
        return {'complete': deleted.returncode == 0 and absent, 'owned_cluster_absent': absent,
                'delete_attempted': True, 'delete_exit_code': deleted.returncode}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, default=Path('service-record.json'))
    parser.add_argument('--check-record', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.check_record:
        record = json.loads(args.check_record.read_text())
        assert record['source_sha256']['service_lab.py'] == source_sha()
        verify(record['observation'])
        assert record['status'] == 'passed' and record['cleanup']['complete'] and record['cleanup']['owned_cluster_absent']
        print('PASS: independent API state and actual ClusterIP HTTP bodies agree')
        return
    lab = Lab()
    report = {'schema': 1, 'status': 'failed', 'system': platform.system(), 'node_image': NODE_IMAGE,
        'python_image': PYTHON_IMAGE, 'source_sha256': {'service_lab.py': source_sha()},
        'scope': 'Native Kubernetes on one kind Linux host with controlled fresh HTTP connections; not cloud load balancers, multi-host networks, fault-domain availability or long-lived connection draining.'}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='infra-service-') as tmp:
        try:
            report['versions'] = lab.run(Path(tmp))
            report['status'] = 'passed'
        except Exception as error:
            # Only allowlist frames in this source file; never serialize error text or locals.
            frames = []
            trace = error.__traceback__
            while trace:
                if Path(trace.tb_frame.f_code.co_filename).resolve() == Path(__file__).resolve():
                    frames.append({'function': trace.tb_frame.f_code.co_name, 'line': trace.tb_lineno})
                trace = trace.tb_next
            report['failure'] = {'stage': lab.stage, 'type': type(error).__name__, 'source_frames': frames}
        finally:
            report['observation'] = lab.observation
            report['cleanup'] = lab.cleanup()
            if not report['cleanup']['complete']:
                report['status'] = 'failed'
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({'status': report['status'], 'failure': report.get('failure'), 'cleanup': report['cleanup']}))
    if report['status'] != 'passed':
        raise SystemExit(1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
完整 README：观察顺序、安全隔离、官方语义与范围
README.md
# 原生 Kubernetes：探针、Service 与版本恢复

先沿一条正常请求认识对象，再改变其中一个条件。Deployment 声明两个业务副本；每个 Pod 有独立 UID；Service 提供稳定 ClusterIP，按标签匹配业务 Pod；EndpointSlice 保存该 Service 后端地址及就绪条件。独立客户端 Pod 持续向 **同一个 ClusterIP:80/work** 发出新 HTTP 请求，应用在响应中回显请求 ID、实际版本、Pod UID 与进程实例 ID。

## 运行

需要 Python 3.9+、Linux、本机 Docker Unix socket、kind **v0.33.0**、kubectl **v1.35.8**。官方工具下载与 SHA256 校验步骤位于仓库 `.github/workflows/kubernetes-service.yml`。

```sh
python3 -B service_lab.py --output service-record.json
python3 -B service_lab.py --check-record service-record.json
```

节点固定为 `kindest/node:v1.35.8@sha256:07b2536e30b803ed61d1677a79df6115f798ce64c80f9e22f6ed45afd09323c0`；应用与客户端使用官方 Python 镜像 `python:3.13.7-alpine3.22@sha256:9ba6d8cbebf0fb6546ae71f2a1c14f6ffd2fdab83af7fa5669734ef30ad48844`。后者是多架构镜像清单摘要，CI 在 Linux amd64 上选择相应清单。

程序只创建随机命名的 `infra-service-*` kind 集群，不接受外部集群参数。每条 kubectl 命令显式使用自己的临时 kubeconfig 与 context；kubeconfig 权限为 0600。拒绝非空 DOCKER_HOST、非 Unix socket 的 Docker context 及其他 kind provider；finally 只删除本次命名集群并确认其消失。三个 Pod 均关闭 ServiceAccount token 自动挂载，执行记录不保存 token、私钥或 kubeconfig 正文。

## 先预测六个阶段

1. **正常 v1**：两个 Pod 均 Ready，两个 EndpointSlice 后端 ready=true；同一 ClusterIP 的响应样本包含两者 UID，版本均为 v1。
2. **readiness 失败**：只在其中一个业务容器创建 `/tmp/not-ready`。该应用 `/ready=503`，`/live=200`、`/work=200`；API 中此 Pod Ready=false、对应端点 ready=false；持续客户端稳定样本只收到另一 UID，两个 Pod 的 restartCount 均保持不变。端点可以仍保留在对象中，不能只数地址。
3. **readiness 恢复**：删除该标记；同一 Pod UID 恢复 Ready，端点重新 ready=true；HTTP 再次包含两者 UID，重启次数仍不变。
4. **单独的 liveness 失败**：创建 `/tmp/not-live`；此时直接探测 `/live=503`、`/ready=200`。kubelet 达到配置阈值后重启该容器。原 Pod UID 保持不变，restartCount 增加一次，响应的进程实例 ID 改变，再经 Service 读到 v1。实验的故障标记位于容器可写层，新容器启动后消失。
5. **发布 v2**：`kubectl set env deployment/guide-service APP_VERSION=v2` 改变 Pod 模板。等待对象收敛后，EndpointSlice 对应新 Pod UID；实际 ClusterIP 响应全部为 v2。
6. **回退 v1**：`kubectl rollout undo ... --to-revision=1` 恢复初始模板。再次等待 Ready 与端点收敛，再从同一 ClusterIP 实际读到 v1。回退范围是 Pod 模板，本例没有迁移数据库或改变外部 ConfigMap 内容。

## 怎样验收

客户端从程序开始持续运行，每条请求都带唯一 ID，使用显式禁用环境代理的 urllib opener，并关闭连接复用；不通过 port-forward，不直连 Pod IP 充当业务路径。管理端的 Pod 内 loopback 请求只用于区分应用的三个接口，记录在 `direct_probe` 中，与 Service 流量分开。

每阶段先轮询 API 的对象条件，再切换客户端阶段标记；等待最后连续 **20 条** HTTP 成功且响应 UID 集合与 ready 后端集合相同。保存抽样窗口前、后的独立 API 快照，并继续核对请求 ID、实际版本、Pod UID、Ready、EndpointSlice 条件及重启次数。记录还保留完整持续请求序列，阶段稳定样本不代表传播期间零失败；不以固定 sleep 推断端点生效。采样是受控有限窗口，不能证明所有未来请求都成功。

`--check-record` 离线验证记录中的对象事实和真实 HTTP 内容，并核对源码 SHA256；不会连接 Docker。站点的离线检查器另有独立的业务验收逻辑及篡改负例，只有显式设置 `INFRA_GUIDE_RUN_KUBERNETES_SERVICE=1` 才新建 kind。

## 范围与原有手册

这是单 Linux 宿主上的 kind 集群，覆盖原生探针、Service 数据路径、Pod 模板发布与回退。它不验证生产云负载均衡、多宿主网络、多故障域可用性、容量、长连接/在途请求排空或 preStop 终止窗口。Python `http.server` 仅用于教学。

原有 `infra-systems/infra_lab.py` 的 loopback、存储与指标实验保持独立；原有 `probe_server.py` / `deployment.yaml` 目标集群手册也保留为历史来源。本实验使用新的双副本夹具和持续客户端，不把旧手册执行状态或本地结果改写成这次原生记录。

## 官方语义

- [Service、选择器与 ClusterIP](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/)
- [readiness 与 liveness 的动作区别](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/probes/)
- [EndpointSlice 的 ready、serving 与 terminating](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/endpoint-slices/)
- [Deployment 更新与回滚的 Pod 模板范围](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/deployment/)
- [kind 安装与官方校验](https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/docs/user/quick-start/)

只有真实运行成功、完成自有集群清理，且记录与冻结源码摘要一致后，才发布原生通过结论。

以下是本次原生实验之前的材料，其中“本轮未执行 / 待验证”描述旧手册当时的状态。旧本地结果仍属于 infra_lab.py；本次记录属于独立的 service_lab.py 双副本与持续客户端夹具，两者分别验收。

修改脚本后应重跑受影响实验，并记录新环境与摘要。本站验证记录只对发布的原始版本成立，不能自动覆盖读者修改后的程序。

展开完整 infra_lab.py
infra_lab.py PYTHON
"""InfraGuide local mechanisms lab. Python 3.9+, standard library only.
No cloud resources or production endpoints are used. See README.md.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import tempfile
import threading
import time
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from urllib.request import urlopen


def http_lab():
    state = {'ready': True}
    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def log_message(self, *args):
            pass
        def do_GET(self):
            status = 200
            if self.path == '/ready':
                status = 200 if state['ready'] else 503
            elif self.path == '/failure':
                status = 503
            elif self.path not in ('/live', '/work'):
                status = 404
            body = json.dumps({'status': status, 'ready': state['ready']}).encode()
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
            self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), Handler)
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    observations = []
    def request(path):
        start = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            with urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:%d%s' % (server.server_port, path), timeout=2) as r:
                status, body = r.status, r.read()
        except HTTPError as e:
            status, body = e.code, e.read()
        observations.append({'path': path, 'status': status,
                             'elapsed_ms': (time.perf_counter()-start)*1000})
        assert json.loads(body)['status'] == status
        return status
    try:
        assert request('/work') == 200
        assert request('/failure') == 503
        assert request('/missing') == 404
        assert request('/ready') == 200
        state['ready'] = False
        assert request('/ready') == 503
        assert request('/live') == 200
        # Simulated readiness is a signal; no orchestrator or traffic router exists here.
        assert request('/work') == 200
        return {'status': 'passed', 'scope': 'Real loopback HTTP; readiness signals only, no Kubernetes.',
                'observations': observations}
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        server.server_close()
        thread.join(timeout=2)


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def validate_version(folder):
    manifest = json.loads((folder/'manifest.json').read_text())
    for name, expected in manifest['files'].items():
        # This tutorial manifest is trusted local input. Production readers must validate paths too.
        data = (folder/name).read_bytes()
        if digest(data) != expected:
            raise ValueError('artifact checksum mismatch: ' + name)
    return manifest


def storage_lab():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='infra-artifacts-') as temporary:
        root = Path(temporary)
        v1 = root/'v1'
        v1.mkdir()
        payload = b'example-model-version-1\n'
        (v1/'model.txt').write_bytes(payload)
        (v1/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'version': 'v1', 'files': {'model.txt': digest(payload)}}))
        validate_version(v1)
        (root/'CURRENT.tmp').write_text('v1')
        os.replace(root/'CURRENT.tmp', root/'CURRENT')
        draft = root/'v2-draft'
        draft.mkdir()
        (draft/'partial.txt').write_text('incomplete')
        # No publish pointer update: consumers still select the last complete version.
        selected = root/(root/'CURRENT').read_text()
        validate_version(selected)
        assert (selected/'model.txt').read_bytes() == payload
        bad = root/'v3-corrupt'
        bad.mkdir()
        (bad/'model.txt').write_bytes(b'corrupt')
        (bad/'manifest.json').write_text((v1/'manifest.json').read_text())
        try:
            validate_version(bad)
        except ValueError:
            rejected = True
        else:
            raise AssertionError('Corrupt version was accepted')
        assert (root/'CURRENT').read_text() == 'v1'
        return {'status':'passed', 'restored_version':'v1', 'incomplete_not_published': True,
                'corrupt_rejected': rejected,
                'scope':'Local filesystem protocol test; not object-store or power-loss durability validation.'}


def slo_stats(groups, target):
    total = sum(row['total'] for row in groups)
    good = sum(row['good'] for row in groups)
    if not 0 < target < 1 or any(not 0 <= r['good'] <= r['total'] for r in groups):
        raise ValueError('Invalid target or event counts')
    if total == 0:
        return {'total':0,'good':0,'success_ratio':None,'burn_rate':None}
    bad = total-good
    allowance = total*(1-target)
    return {'total':total,'good':good,'bad':bad,'success_ratio':good/total,
            'allowed_bad':allowance,'budget_remaining':allowance-bad,
            'burn_rate':(bad/total)/(1-target)}


def slo_lab():
    groups = [{'name':'A','total':900,'good':899}, {'name':'B','total':100,'good':90}]
    result = slo_stats(groups, .99)
    assert result['total'] == 1000 and result['bad'] == 11
    assert math.isclose(result['burn_rate'], 1.1)
    assert slo_stats([], .99)['success_ratio'] is None
    naive = sum(g['good']/g['total'] for g in groups)/len(groups)
    assert not math.isclose(naive, result['success_ratio'])
    # A separate quantile fixture; nearest-rank definition is explicit.
    samples = [10]*99 + [1000]
    p99 = sorted(samples)[math.ceil(.99*len(samples))-1]
    assert p99 == 10
    return {'status':'passed','scope':'Synthetic event-count and latency fixtures, not production measurements.',
            'aggregate':result,'incorrect_unweighted_ratio':naive,
            'global_p99_nearest_rank_ms':p99,'incorrect_mean_of_instance_p99_ms':505}


def inference_lab():
    traces = [
        {'id':'A','sent':0.,'scheduled':.2,'first':.4,'last':1.4,'tokens':51,'ok':True},
        {'id':'B','sent':.2,'scheduled':.3,'first':.5,'last':.5,'tokens':1,'ok':True},
        {'id':'C','sent':.3,'last':.7,'tokens':0,'ok':False},
    ]
    good = [t for t in traces if t['ok']]
    per_request = [{'id':t['id'],'client_ttft_ms':(t['first']-t['sent'])*1000,
                    'scheduled_to_first_ms':(t['first']-t['scheduled'])*1000,
                    'tpot_ms':(t['last']-t['first'])*1000/(t['tokens']-1) if t['tokens']>1 else None}
                   for t in good]
    assert math.isclose(per_request[0]['client_ttft_ms'],400)
    assert math.isclose(per_request[0]['tpot_ms'],20)
    assert per_request[1]['tpot_ms'] is None
    span = max(t['last'] for t in traces)-min(t['sent'] for t in traces)
    return {'status':'passed','scope':'Hand-authored trace fixture; no model, GPU or serving engine executed.',
            'requests':per_request,'failure_fraction':1/3,
            'output_tokens_per_second':sum(t['tokens'] for t in good)/span,'observation_seconds':span}


def manifest_lab():
    def validate(m):
        for key in ('run_id','image_digest','code_revision','data_version','output_uri'):
            if not isinstance(m.get(key), str) or not m[key]:
                raise ValueError('missing field: '+key)
        if not isinstance(m.get('workers'), int) or isinstance(m['workers'],bool) or m['workers']<1:
            raise ValueError('workers must be a positive integer')
        if m.get('recovery_boundary') not in ('epoch','none'):
            raise ValueError('unsupported recovery boundary')
    example = {'run_id':'demo-001','image_digest':'sha256:'+'a'*64,
               'code_revision':'example-revision','data_version':'synthetic-v1',
               'output_uri':'example://isolated-output/demo-001','workers':2,'recovery_boundary':'epoch'}
    validate(example)
    broken = dict(example)
    del broken['data_version']
    try:
        validate(broken)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError('Missing data version accepted')
    return {'status':'passed','example':example,
            'scope':'Field/shape validation only. Example references are fictional; artifact existence, IAM and scheduling not validated.'}


def run_all():
    return {'environment':platform.system()+' '+platform.machine()+' Python '+platform.python_version(),
            'results':{'http':http_lab(),'storage':storage_lab(),'slo':slo_lab(),
                       'inference_metrics':inference_lab(),'manifest':manifest_lab()}}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--output', default='runs/core-report.json')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    report = run_all()
    destination = Path(args.output)
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

概念回顾：本章对象与关系

概念与关系

1先有实际处理请求的服务进程

服务对外接收请求，进程是它的一次运行实例。版本标识具体程序或配置。机器上的进程存在，不代表当前版本已经能够正确处理用户输入。

2健康探测与用户结果各自提供证据

探针是按规定发起的健康检查；指标汇总请求和资源表现；发布让某个版本接入实际流量。探针通过、版本切换与业务正确需要分别观察。

3再从本机运行走向集群验收

本章先执行本地服务、请求与指标，再解释如何把相应信号交给Kubernetes。目标集群手册按其环境继续验证，不把本地结果直接当成集群已运行。

?迁移练习

readiness失败后，通过Pod port-forward仍能访问/work，是否说明Service摘流失败？

展开参考答案与推理

不能。port-forward直接到Pod可能绕过Service端点选择。应观察Pod与EndpointSlice就绪条件，并从符合真实路由路径的客户端验证Service行为。
